hero.1: See the invisible forces that move price.
hero.2: RT Magneto brings options-market positioning onto your futures chart: the gamma exposure ladder, delta and convexity, plus the Zero Gamma pivot and the levels with the highest concentration of exposure, which act as magnets for price. Options-flow spikes reveal the large hedging positions taken by the Market Maker and Dealers. The net gamma or delta exposure flow indicator shows market sentiment and regime.
niebla.2: Without a map, the market looks random: conflicting indicators, noise and emotional decisions. Beneath price there is a structure you can see.
niebla.3: Keep scrolling: the fog clears and three planes appear. They are the levels drawn by dealer hedging.
sala.1: The market has an engine room.
sala.2: The force is generated in options. You drive the future. RT Magneto connects the two and puts the structure that comes from the options market on your futures chart.
sala.3: Options underlying and the future where it is shown
sala.6: Options: where the force is generated
sala.7: Every call and every put that trades changes dealer exposure. That is the energy that drives the system.
sala.9: It calculates the gamma and delta exposure of the options underlying and carries it to the matching future.
sala.10: Your future: the structure on your chart
sala.11: Zero Gamma and the GEX+ and GEX− magnets appear as levels on your candles.
cobertura.1: The market maker doesn't bet. It hedges.
cobertura.2: Dealers sell options and don't seek direction: they neutralize their delta by buying or selling futures. When price moves, gamma forces them to adjust that hedge, and that forced flow leaves a footprint on the chart.
cobertura.7: Delta tells you where the dealer is now. Gamma tells you what it will have to do when price moves.
spike.2: Every large options order appears as a dot with two layers. The outer ring is convexity: whether the flow buys or sells options and how much volatility it expects. The inner circle is GEX: whether the exposure is on the call side or the put side. Read them together.
spike.4: Cyan ring, green core. Bullish conviction and high expected volatility.
spike.6: Cyan ring, red core. Bearish conviction and high expected volatility.
spike.8: Purple ring, red core. Stagnation or resistance above, no breakout conviction.
spike.10: Purple ring, green core. Stagnation or solid support; a range view.
spike.11: Don't just ask which way. Ask how much: a cyan spike marks the highest expectation of a big move, up or down.
escalera.2: Each rung is a strike. To the right, positive exposure: dealers dampen the move. To the left, negative: they amplify it. RT Magneto shows it two ways, and comparing them helps you see whether real positioning is shifting.
escalera.5: Illustrative ladder, generated to explain the concept. This is not market data.
regimenes.3: Dealers are long gamma: they buy dips and sell rallies. Volatility compresses and price tends to revert to the mean.
regimenes.5: Dealers are short gamma: they sell as price falls. Ranges expand and the market is prone to breakouts.
regimenes.6: In GEX+, think like a contrarian. In GEX−, think like a trend follower.
niveles.3: A magnet that pulls price in and often causes reversals. In positive gamma it works as a point of equilibrium.
niveles.5: The line in the sand: where dealers' net gamma changes sign. It is a context filter, not a trigger: trade the acceptance, not the touch.
niveles.7: Where price can accelerate. In negative gamma, levels stop being magnets and act as real support or resistance.
niveles.8: When price crosses Zero Gamma and holds on the other side, the regime can change: from gravity to acceleration, or the other way round. That is why you trade the acceptance of the cross, not the first touch.
horizontes.2: 0DTE reflects the day's flow: fast, sensitive and changing, especially near the close. 90DTE reflects slower, structural positioning. RT Magneto shows you both.
horizontes.3: Above both pivots: bullish bias, stability and compression.
horizontes.4: Below both: bearish bias and volatility expansion.
horizontes.5: Between the two: a conflict zone. More false breakouts; the prudent move is to wait for it to resolve.
indicador.1: Everything you see on the chart.
indicador.2: RT Magneto adds two layers to your futures chart. On the main chart, the levels you choose and the options-flow spikes. On the sub-chart, 0DTE sentiment from the options market.
indicador.3: A 3D recreation of the indicator, built from a real NinjaTrader screenshot. Scroll to walk through it part by part.
indicador.5: The level with the highest concentration of positive gamma exposure. The major GEX+ magnet is calculated from the day's volume. This is where dealer hedging tends to slow rallies.
indicador.7: Cyan dots: the level with the strongest options buying flow. A sign of conviction and higher expected volatility.
indicador.9: Large options orders at the moment they hit. The outer ring shows convexity; the core, GEX.
indicador.11: The yellow line marks the change of regime or context, and it moves during the day. Above it, a stable environment (positive gamma regime); below it, a volatile environment (negative gamma regime).
indicador.13: Blue dots: the level with the strongest options selling flow. It points to range and stagnation.
indicador.15: The level with the highest concentration of negative gamma exposure. The GEX− magnet is calculated from the day's volume. It is the floor: if price falls below these levels, the selloff accelerates.
indicador.17: On the 0DTE sentiment sub-chart, green means calls dominate.
indicador.19: Purple means puts dominate. Moving from one zone to the other confirms the intraday shift.
sentimiento.1: Confirm the shift as it happens.
sentimiento.2: The sentiment indicator shows whether total 0DTE options flow is dominated by puts or by calls. The transition point gives real-time confirmation of intraday shifts.
escenarios.1: Four scenarios. A map for each.
escenarios.2: Depending on where price sits relative to Zero Gamma and the GEX levels, the entry and the targets change.
escenarios.4: From Zero Gamma toward Max GEX+. Dealers long gamma. Pullback entry, buying dips; target at the magnet.
escenarios.6: From Zero Gamma toward Max GEX−. Dealers short gamma. Entry by selling the bounce that fails at the pivot.
escenarios.8: Price at Max GEX+. Look for a reversal confirmed in the order flow; target back toward Zero Gamma.
escenarios.10: Price at Max GEX− and breaking. After a small consolidation, trade with the momentum.
metodo.3: Spot shifts in conviction in the flow: long convexity that signals volatility expansion.
metodo.5: Compare price with Zero Gamma to know whether the environment is stable or volatile.
metodo.7: Use the magnets as targets and as support and resistance, instead of trading price blind.
metodo.8: Knowing when not to trade is also structure.
metodo.9: Before macro data such as CPI, FOMC or NFP.
metodo.10: When GEX is neutral or contradictory.
metodo.11: When the order flow doesn't confirm.
